signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION ZLA_GBRCOND_C( TRANS, N, KL, KU, AB,

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the form of the system of equations:

-   `= 'N'`: $A \, X = B$     (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $A^H \, X = B$  (Conjugate Transpose = Transpose)

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: On entry, the matrix A in band storage, in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: `AB(KU+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{KU}) \le i \le \min (N,j+\mathrm{kl})$

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: AFB
params.reference: Details of the LU factorization of the band matrix A, as computed by ZGBTRF. U is stored as an upper triangular band matrix with `KL`+`KU` superdiagonals in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1, and the multipliers used during the factorization are stored in rows `KL`+`KU`+2 to $2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: ldafb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AFB`. $\mathrm{LDAFB} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices from the factorization $A = P \, L \, U$ as computed by ZGBTRF; row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: c
params.reference: The vector C in the formula $\operatorname{op}(A) \, \operatorname{inv}(\operatorname{diag}(C))$.

params.name: capply
params.reference: If .TRUE. then access the vector C in the formula above.

params.name: info
params.reference: -   `= 0`: Successful exit. $i > 0$:  The ith argument is invalid.
